# Configuration reference

Every resource envelope an embedder can set, with the default construction observed in source. Defaults are read from the source literal of the documented constructor, never duplicated by hand.

## `supersql.OpenOptions`

OpenOptions configures Open. Clock is required and borrowed: the host owns
provider startup and shutdown and must close the database before closing the
provider, because a live database holds fences certified by that provider.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Directory | string | none; required | Directory is the database directory. Open creates it when absent. |
| Compaction | CompactionConfig | zero value selects `neosepia.DefaultLimits()` | Compaction replaces the NeoSepia default limits when nonzero. |
| Clock | clock.Clock | none; required | Clock is the certified time source borrowed by the database. |
| Maintenance | MaintenanceConfig | - | Maintenance bounds the background reclamation loop Open starts. The zero value selects the defaults; Maintenance.Disabled stops the loop. |
| HistoricalReadOnly | bool | false | HistoricalReadOnly opens the database without requiring fresh certified readiness: no writes and no latest reads are accepted, only retained historical snapshots are served. The clock may be unsynchronized. |
| Parallelism | int | - | Parallelism sets the execution worker pool concurrency. Zero or negative selects runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0). |
| MemoryBudgetBytes | uint64 | - | MemoryBudgetBytes overrides the shared query memory budget (default 256 MiB). |
| TransactionMemoryBytes | uint64 | - | TransactionMemoryBytes overrides the per-transaction in-memory staging limit (default 8 MiB). |
| TransactionSpillBytes | uint64 | - | TransactionSpillBytes overrides the per-transaction spill limit (default 32 MiB). |
| MaxTransactions | int | - | MaxTransactions overrides the maximum concurrent active transactions (default 64). |
| MaxOperations | int | - | MaxOperations overrides the maximum concurrent snapshot/read operations (default 64). |

Open rejects an empty `Directory` with `ErrDirectoryRequired`, a nil or unavailable `Clock` with `ErrClockRequired`, and maps an incompatible directory layout to `*UpgradeRequired`. A nonzero `Compaction` replaces the whole backend envelope rather than merging field by field.

## `supersql.MaintenanceConfig`

MaintenanceConfig bounds the background maintenance loop started by Open.
Maintenance reclaims published commit segments and obsolete run files through
the retention coordinator and the backend's collection engine.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Disabled | bool | Disabled stops Open from starting the loop. The embedder then owns reclamation: nothing else retires commits/ or runs/ files. |
| Interval | time.Duration | Interval is the probe period. Zero selects DefaultMaintenanceInterval; values below MinMaintenanceInterval are rejected by Open. |
| WALThreshold | uint64 | WALThreshold is the published commit-segment count at which one pass runs. Zero selects DefaultWALThreshold. |
| RunThreshold | uint64 | RunThreshold is the live run-file count at which one pass runs. Zero selects DefaultRunThreshold. |
| MaxRetiredTargets | uint64 | MaxRetiredTargets caps the retired objects one pass collects. Zero selects DefaultMaxRetiredTargets. |
